propositions: Batch-path verdicts systematically returned confidence=0.0 due to unspecified fields in the JSON schema contract, causing aggregate filtering to reject all pairs below the 0.7 threshold.
Output token limit of 1024 bytes truncated multi-candidate batches (K=6 or more), causing the entire batch to be rejected and abstained rather than returning verdicts.
The overlap feature has never surfaced a finding to reviewers despite 2,093 plan reviews, consuming ~$165/5 days in LLM spend with zero output.
Fixed by requiring candidate_id, relation, confidence, and abstain fields in the batch entry contract and scaling output budget dynamically to 256+192*n tokens per batch.
Live calibration confirmed near-duplicate pairs now surface with confidence >= 0.95 while unrelated pairs remain unsurfaced at 0.97-0.98.
